item.title: Police officer praised for defending right to preach in Muslim area
item.description: A female police officer who apparently defended the rights of a Christian street preacher against complaints from a crowd of Muslim men in London has been praised for her actions.

item.title: Christians support X in legal challenge against EU's 120 million euro fine
item.description: The fine was handed down on 5 December last year for alleged breaches of transparency and procedural obligations under the EU’s Digital Services Act.

item.title: Presbyterian Church in Ireland urged to return to God during safeguarding crisis
item.description: The Moderator of the Presbyterian Church in Ireland (PCI) has said the denomination is going through “an ecclesiastical earthquake”.

item.title: Disappointment after Welsh Senedd members back assisted suicide bill
item.description: Senedd members voted narrowly in favour of a Legislative Consent Motion on Kim Leadbeater's Terminally Ill Adults (End of Life) Bill.

item.title: Over 40,000 people were helped by Bristol churches last year
item.description: Some 1,634 volunteers gave 121,660 hours of service over the past 12 months to support a range of community hubs and initiatives across the Diocese of Bristol.

item.title: Jennifer Melle returns to work, but says fight is not over yet
item.description: An employment tribunal and two investigations by the Nursing and Midwifery Council remain outstanding.

item.title: Drug kingpin killed in Mexico headed cartel that had targeted churches
item.description: For merely “opening a church,” pastors receive messages demanding large sums of money.

item.title: Christian faces death threats in refugee camp in South Sudan
item.description: “My family wants me dead,” the convert from Islam said.

item.title: Ukraine bishop: 'You never know when your time will come'
item.description: Parts of the Catholic Kharkiv-Zaporizhzhia Diocese are controlled by Russian forces.

item.title: Churches 'left in the lurch' as government repair scheme runs out of money
item.description: The Listed Places of Worship Grant Scheme has run out of money but a new replacement fund is not yet up and running.
